issues.description: The municipality identifier (gemeindeschluessel) referenced for Aufgabe 03 is inconsistent between the problem text and the reference solution. problem_statement.md (Aufgabe 03) requests Zoos in the municipality with gemeindeschluessel '09162000', but solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql filters WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162001'. This mismatch will cause confusion for students and make automated tests or example results disagree with the written task.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the municipality key consistent across artifacts. Either update problem_statement.md (Aufgabe 03) to request gemeindeschluessel '09162001' to match solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql, or change solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql to WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162000' and update any tests and example outputs accordingly. Also update the template (aufgabe03.sql) or its comments to show the chosen key so students see the intended target.
